policies.sentence: Students must not share personal, identifying or confidential data with AI tools, and should keep AI from storing their results.
AI tools store and analyze prompts and can leak confidential data.
Course chatbot interactions are logged, and enrollment implies consent to use of student submissions.
The instructor does not consent to class being recorded by AI tools.
Students must use AI responsibly and ethically, understand tool limits and terms, and ensure compliance with university policies.
Students must purchase a Claude Pro subscription for the project and should expect two to three months of cost.
Students may pay for frontier AI access but are not required to spend money on AI tools.
AI training data is usually harvested from the internet without consent.
AI-generated code is based on others' code and may come with licenses it does not carry over.
AI systems depend on moderation labor by human workers.
AI systems consume huge amounts of energy and water and create real resource costs.
The instructor judges the resource costs of students using AI on this task to be acceptable.
LLMs raise serious ethical issues, and AI misuse can harm others.
